_comment: Candidate NPC body looks, OFF by default (scripts/characters/character_model.gd with_body_flags). An enabled flag merges its per-character body_albedo_override over that character's art.json entry (rig, clips, palette, accessories untouched; an appearance variant still wins). The GPU judges an arm by flipping enabled.

npc_vis_body_wandering_trainer._why: VIS-CREATURES (1 Nov). F36 (0) #26 5.80 installed / 5.93 face-material candidate on GPU frames (ralph/reports/CREATURES/close-1020/f36-0-ledger.md); the judges put the ceiling in the baked albedo: 'low-resolution eyes and mouths, blotches, chalky skin'. Same atlas and identity: skin loses its chalk and blotches, eyes/brows/mouth crisped by local contrast, darkest cloth lifted a step. Grade: tools/art_pipeline/grade_vis_npcs.py.

npc_vis_look_kael._why: VIS-CREATURES group 5 (1 Nov). Judges on the villager and grunt anchors (about 5.8-6.6): soft flat face with tiny dot eyes and no catchlight; no rim or key light; stiff A-pose; muddy low-contrast materials. Identity kept (same atlas, rig and palette): albedo grade (skin chalk and blotches evened, eyes/brows/mouth crisped, darkest cloth lifted a step with saturated red excluded, small eye catchlights; tools/art_pipeline/grade_vis_npcs.py); a daylight rim (0.45) so the face and silhouette separate in close-ups and dialogue (this playable profile keeps its night rim instead); a relaxed idle (upper arms lowered 22 deg, elbows bent 8 deg) in place of the A-pose.
